backend/main.mo: Defines types and logic for Callaway scoring, stores submitted events, and processes results using a predefined deduction chart.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists summarized descriptions of multiple frontend files and their roles in the app.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer documentation describing how to modify the default Callaway charts and their data structure.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes restoration of a draft state without functional changes, documenting the current app features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining global color tokens, theming variables, and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up root container and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main routing and scoring flow logic handling event setup, score entry, and leaderboard display.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with attribution link and copyright text.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component showing title, navigation buttons, and optional admin access.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin view displaying either a locked message or a panel explaining backend-managed chart control.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Renders an editor for customizable Callaway scoring charts, allowing tabbed editing, validation, saving, and resetting chart values.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Provides a form for configuring event details such as title, course, golfer count, holes, and par, with validation before submitting.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a golfer’s Callaway score breakdown, including gross, deduction, adjustment, net, and hole-by-hole scores.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Shows the backend Callaway scoring chart with score ranges, deductions, and adjustments, plus explanatory notes.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print-optimized HTML view of tournament standings and opens it in a new window for PDF printing.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Renders tournament standings with ranking logic, showing net, gross, deduction, adjustment, and rank icons.
Combines event setup, golfer data, and backend chart to compute and display standings, breakdowns, chart info, and PDF export.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfer score entry cards with editable names and hole scores, updating parent state on changes.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data, ensuring names are present and hole scores match expected counts and numeric constraints.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: UI for application settings, including toggling admin access and returning to the previous screen.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Hook providing reactive admin-access state by listening to localStorage and custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, and status handling through a React context and AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching backend data such as the latest result and Callaway chart via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a golf-themed light/dark color palette with font configuration.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Implements Callaway score calculation using backend chart entries, handling worst-hole deductions, fractional holes, and par-based rules.
Defines Callaway chart types and legacy 9/18‑hole chart constants plus a helper to find the matching chart entry.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Handles loading, saving, resetting, and migrating edited Callaway grid charts via localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Provides utilities for detecting and handling placeholder grid cells in Callaway charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin-access flag using localStorage and emits change events.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript shapes for event setup, golfer data, and Callaway result data.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, plugins, and animations for the frontend.
project_state.json: Captures project metadata and pending feature requests focused on reverting backend scoring and chart changes.
